# LINK Advance

## Tools (all free, on-screen, no email wall)
- [Home Loan Health Check](https://linkadvance.com.au/home-loan-health-check): score your loan out of 10 across rate, review, structure, fit, equity and attention
- [Borrowing power calculator](https://linkadvance.com.au/borrowing-power-calculator): assessed the way lenders do: net income, expense floors, the 3% APRA buffer, the 3.8%/month card-limit rule
- [Repayments calculator](https://linkadvance.com.au/home-loan-repayment-calculator): monthly/fortnightly/weekly, total interest, +3% stress test, extra-repayment savings
- [LMI calculator](https://linkadvance.com.au/lenders-mortgage-insurance-calculator): indicative premiums by LVR plus the four ways to avoid LMI
- [Stamp duty QLD calculator](https://linkadvance.com.au/stamp-duty-calculator-qld): 2026 rates incl. zero duty for first-home new builds
